title: Sulfonated porous organic polymers: strategic design, synthesis, and applications in catalysis, adsorption, and energy-related processes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,2635-2690
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00918A, Review Article
Open Access

Ali Reza Oveisi, Saba Daliran, Matías Blanco, Amarajothi Dhakshinamoorthy, Unal Sen, José Alemán, Hermenegildo García
This review details how strategic sulfonic acid incorporation in diverse POPs (e.g., COFs, CTFs, PAFs, CMPs, PIMs) creates multifunctional materials engineered for catalysis, adsorption, and energy applications.
